properties.evidence: A view that slices by ALTITUDE needs to know what the altitudes ARE, and this decision is what settles that. It is the precise dependency: the altitude view is the missing half of the lowest-level-contract rule (that rule is accepted, its roll-up view is not built), and an open ladder means the rungs it projects onto are per-design rather than a fixed five. ⚠️ AND IT IS NOT ONLY A VIEW: `seam_coverage` ALREADY takes an altitude argument and answers differently per rung — 72/8/64 at module, 11/11/0 at subsystem — so at least one shipped tool keys on the ladder today. That dependency is NOT in the five unsettled items listed on the ladder decision and belongs there.
